name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.userinfo.FunUserInfoActivity
description: When a user opens a person's profile, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads contact or AI-account details and offers actions such as chatting, adding a friend, blocking, or removing a friend.
disableEffect: Users lose the ContactKit page for viewing a person's details and using its contact actions.
